Definition: Whether primary laws, acts, or legal instruments exist that establish authority for cross-government data sharing and govern the data exchange system
Comments: Rwanda has Data Protection and Privacy Law (No. 058/2021) and Access to Information Law in force. However, the interoperability study (2017) noted lack of laws requiring agencies to integrate.
